name: cte
input: with recent as (select id,user_id,total from orders where created_at>current_date) select u.id,r.total from users u join recent r on r.user_id=u.id;

select u.id, r.total
from users u
         join recent r on r.user_id = u.id;

name: join_where

from users u

order by o.total desc;
